description: A shell script for automating performance benchmarking of an Android app, including device setup, UI interaction, performance data collection, and reporting.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays help information for script usage.

methods.name: require_cmd
methods.description: Checks if a command is available in the system.

methods.name: adb_cmd
methods.description: Executes adb commands, optionally with a specific device serial.

methods.name: dump_ui
methods.description: Dumps the current UI hierarchy to an XML file.

methods.name: ui_has
methods.description: Checks if a UI pattern exists in the current UI hierarchy.

methods.name: wait_for_pattern
methods.description: Waits until a specific UI pattern appears or times out.

methods.name: ensure_connected
methods.description: Verifies the app is in a connected state.

methods.name: ensure_screen_online
methods.description: Ensures the screen WebView is active.

methods.name: ensure_chat_online
methods.description: Ensures the chat input is active.

methods.name: capture_mem
methods.description: Captures memory info of the app.

methods.name: measure_launch
methods.description: Measures app launch times and connection times.
